around.headline: Bike-borne chain snatchers attack a woman in Peenya
around.summary: A woman was injured when men on a bike snatched her chain and attacked her in Peenya today. If you're walking alone with visible jewellery on a quiet stretch, keep it tucked in and move toward a lit, populated area rather than staying on empty roads after dark.

around.headline: Karnataka bandh call withdrawn after meeting with CM
around.summary: Kannada activists called off today's statewide bandh over the Cauvery water-sharing row after meeting CM DK Shivakumar, and the day passed with a low response in Bengaluru — schools and shops functioned normally. Tomorrow's commute should be unaffected by this particular dispute.
around.source: The Times of India, Hindustan Times

around.headline: Draft policy could charge up to ₹25,000/year for street parking
around.summary: A new draft GBA policy proposes charging car owners for on-street parking in Bengaluru, potentially up to ₹25,000 annually depending on location. Worth watching if you rely on free street parking near home or work — the final rates and rollout area aren't locked in yet.
around.source: NDTV, NDTV Profit, The Siasat Daily

around.headline: Ananth Nagar residents protest after woman's fatal road accident
around.summary: Residents came out to protest today demanding fixes to the damaged, unbarricaded road stretch where a woman fell and was fatally run over this week. If a similar hazard exists near you, a logged BBMP complaint (helpline 1533 or the Sahaaya app) carries more weight toward action than a protest alone.

around.headline: CAG: Namma Metro lost ₹104 crore on discounted IKEA land deal
around.summary: A fresh CAG finding says Namma Metro undercharged on a land deal with IKEA by fixing a lower premium, costing ₹104 crore, and separately flags that Phase 1 skipped platform screen doors despite the cost savings being small. Another sign the metro's finances are under real scrutiny right now.

around.headline: Air India orders dope tests for all pilots after a captain tested positive for marijuana
around.summary: Air India is testing all its pilots for drugs after one captain was found positive for marijuana. If you're flying domestically soon, it's a reminder that cockpit drug-testing protocols exist and are actively being enforced right now, not just a paperwork formality.

street_smart.title: You're walking home alone on a quiet stretch, wearing a gold chain, when a bike with two men slows down and circles back toward you — like today's chain-snatching attack in Peenya. What do you do?
street_smart.based_on: Real incident today: a woman was injured when bike-borne men snatched her chain and attacked her in Bengaluru's Peenya (The Times of India).
street_smart.situation: It's early evening on a stretch with few people around. A bike carrying two riders passes you, slows down further up the road, and turns back toward you — the same pattern police describe in today's Peenya chain-snatching case. What do you do?

choices.text: Keep walking at the same pace on the same empty stretch, assuming they're probably just turning around for an unrelated reason.
choices.feedback: This is the trap. Bike-borne snatchers rely on exactly this hesitation — by the time the bike is close enough to grab your chain, you've lost the seconds you needed to change your position or draw attention.

choices.text: Quickly tuck the chain inside your clothing and speed up while staying on the same empty road.
choices.feedback: Risky. Hiding the chain helps, but you're still isolated — if they've already spotted it, a moving target on an empty stretch is still an easy target. Getting around people matters as much as concealing the jewellery.

choices.text: Turn and walk toward the nearest shop, streetlight, or group of people, and call 112 if the bike keeps following.
choices.feedback: Correct. Snatchers depend on isolation and speed; moving toward witnesses and light removes both advantages, and 112 (India's unified emergency number) gets police dispatched while you're still describing the bike and riders.

choices.text: Confront the bike directly and stand your ground to show you're not an easy target.
choices.feedback: Also a trap. A chain-snatching attempt is a grab-and-run crime, not a negotiation — confronting them face-on gives them a stationary target and raises the chance of injury during the grab, which is exactly what happened in today's Peenya case.

takeaways: On quiet stretches, keep jewellery tucked under clothing rather than visible — it's the single easiest thing to control.
Moving toward light, shops, or other people breaks the isolation that bike-borne snatchers depend on — do this before they close the distance, not after.

Call 112 (India's unified police/fire/ambulance number) while the bike and riders are still in view — a plate number or description given in the moment is far more useful to police than one recalled later.

quiz.question: In which Bengaluru locality did bike-borne chain snatchers attack and injure a woman today?
quiz.why: Peenya is a major industrial and residential locality in northwest Bengaluru, and today's attack there is a reminder that street robbery patterns like this aren't confined to any one part of the city.

quiz.question: What happened to today's Karnataka bandh call over the Cauvery water-sharing row?
options: It was withdrawn after Kannada activists met the CM
It was extended to a two-day shutdown
It was called off by a court order
It went ahead as planned with a full shutdown
quiz.why: Vatal Nagaraj's bandh call lost momentum after several Kannada organisations withdrew support and activists met CM DK Shivakumar, which is why Bengaluru saw a low-key, largely normal Thursday.

quiz.question: Under Bengaluru's new draft parking policy reported today, on-street parking could cost car owners up to roughly how much a year?
quiz.why: The draft GBA policy proposes location-based charges for street parking, with the upper end reported at around ₹25,000 annually — exact final rates aren't locked in yet.

quiz.question: Under the Indian Constitution, which List places 'Police' and 'Public Order' under state jurisdiction?
quiz.why: This is why policing, including how a case like today's Peenya chain-snatching is investigated, is primarily a state government responsibility rather than a central one.

quiz.question: Which is the smallest Indian state by area?
quiz.why: Goa covers just over 3,700 sq km, making it India's smallest state, though it's far from the least populous on a density basis.
